decision_relevance_rules.R1_own_evidence: item's own evidence E is decision-relevant by construction
decision_relevance_rules.R4_negated_units: negated unit is decision-relevant iff its base unit is
decision_relevance_rules.scoring_rule: scored iff view contains >=1 decision-relevant unit with defined Y*; under frozen 2-of-3 partition all non-remove views are scored

label_use: gold label used ONLY offline to construct the balanced design; never sent to agents, never used in probing or scoring

oracle_definition.reverse: Y* = flip(Y0) (natural counter-evidence swap; responsiveness axis)
oracle_definition.synthetic_reverse: Y* = flip(Y0) (secondary only, NOT in BF_q; frozen comparability)

primary_composite: BF_q = mean over agents of faithfulness across {paraphrase, reverse}
